text:
marta: Heads-up — a user hit a blocker during onboarding with the Ruby sample. When their short-lived token rotates the SDK returns a 401 and the sample app surfaces an error. JS SDK auto-refreshes+retries so the UX is different.

marta: Minimal repro: clone samples/ruby, run with a test token that expires in 30s, call /chat after expiry -> Net::HTTPUnauthorized returned.

lee: I remember we avoided automatic refresh in Ruby because of racy refreshes under concurrency. Is this a single-thread repro or did they hit it under load?

marta: single request repro from their dev laptop. They expect parity with other SDKs for onboarding. I opened a small PR to add an opt-in auto-refresh and a concurrency guard: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/118

sdk-team: skimmed the PR. Two quick asks: (1) ensure we have a bounded retry loop (honor max_retries) + exponential backoff with jitter, (2) add a test that spawns multiple threads to assert only one refresh call runs.

marta: added a retry wrapper that uses max_retries and backoff with jitter, and a Mutex + condition variable to coordinate refreshes. Diff excerpt:```ruby
def with_auth_retry
  attempt = 0
  begin
    yield
  rescue AuthError
    attempt += 1
    raise if attempt > config.max_retries
    if config.auto_refresh
      refresh_token_once_with_lock
      sleep(exponential_backoff_with_jitter(attempt))
      retry
    else
      raise
    end
  end
end
```

sdk-team: nice. please also expose an ENV override `REDWOOD_RUBY_AUTO_REFRESH=false` so ops can quickly opt-out if they see unexpected behavior. Add a migration note in CHANGELOG and update samples/README to show how to disable.

ci-bot: CI: matrix job ruby-3.2 / ubuntu-latest failed on first run due to a flaky network gem fetch. Rerun triggered.

manager-amy: product note: changing default behavior impacts customers. Recommend default true for DX but make opt-out easy and call it out in the changelog + release notes. Also ask support to watch errors next week.

marta: set default auto_refresh: true, added ENV override and migration note in CHANGELOG. Updated samples/simple_app.rb to show `client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'], auto_refresh: false)` for folks who opt-out. Pushed tests as well.

sdk-team: ran the concurrent-refresh unit test locally (8 threads) — passes and asserts only one refresh was invoked. CI green on rerun.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed on rerun.

manager-amy: please post a short heads-up in #support and #new-hires after the release. Also add an entry in the onboarding checklist referencing the sample behavior.

marta: will do. merging after a quick maintainer review. Resolving here. :white_check_mark:
